context: Tests whether the agent reverse-engineers a C# / Blazor .NET 10 solution into AI Unified Process artifacts: feature clustering in PLAN.md, mapping C# EF Core entities to AI Unified Process vocabulary (Long, String, Decimal, etc.), discovering actors from Blazor AuthorizeView/[Authorize], and grouping Blazor @page endpoints into use cases.

checklist.name: PLAN.md exists
checklist.description: A docs/PLAN.md file is present and non-empty

checklist.name: Blazor entry points listed
checklist.description: PLAN.md contains an explicit list of Blazor .razor page components found during initial scan

checklist.name: Feature clustering documented
checklist.description: PLAN.md groups entry points into feature clusters before specs are written

checklist.name: No C# or SQL types in entity model
checklist.description: docs/entity_model.md does NOT contain raw C# or SQL types (long, string, decimal, int, bigint, varchar) — only AI Unified Process vocabulary types (Long, String, Integer, Decimal, Boolean, Date, DateTime)

checklist.name: AIUP types used
checklist.description: docs/entity_model.md uses AI Unified Process Data Types (Long, String, Decimal, etc.) mapped from EF Core entity properties

checklist.name: UC IDs grouped by actor
checklist.description: Use case IDs (UC-001, UC-002, …) are assigned in actor groups

checklist.name: Endpoints aggregated into use cases
checklist.description: The number of use case files is fewer than the total number of .razor pages — confirming endpoints were aggregated by goal
